$comment: Parity table (protocol v9 addendum §3): every runtime check of plans/ledger-ui/design/smoke.mjs, keyed <slug of the check name>.<occurrence>. slice: the slice that owns it (by the tab or feature it exercises). status: pass | fail (owned by a built slice and failing in the last recorded UI run; gate R stays red until it passes) | pending-slice (its slice is not built yet) | na (cannot apply to the UI; reason says why). line: first line of the smoke.mjs statement that runs it. ui: the UI selectors the adapter resolved for it. note: a person's diagnosis, kept by every tool. Regenerate ids with plans/ledger-ui/loop/tools/parity-sync.ts; record UI statuses with bun test/parity/run.ts --slice S<k> --record.
